metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Posts another limited practice session
metadata.description: Wayne (knee) was a limited practice participant Thursday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
metadata.analysis: Wayne was also limited Wednesday, so his status for Sunday's clash against New England is hazy. Unless he's able to upgrade to full participation Friday, the wideout will likely be tagged with a designation heading into the weekend. In his debut with the Dolphins this past Sunday versus Tennessee, Wayne didn't draw a target on 10 offensive snaps while also playing six snaps on special teams.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Dealing with knee injury
metadata.description: Wayne (knee) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Wayne may have picked up the injury during the Dolphins' Week 7 win over the Jets, when he played 16 snaps (10 on offense, six on special teams) without showing up on the box score otherwise. He'll have two more chances to increase his practice participation and avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's AFC East showdown against New England. Wayne has not recorded a target in each of his last three outings after turning 12 targets into four catches for 65 yards through the first three games of the regular season as a member of the Texans.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Claimed off waivers by Miami
metadata.description: Wayne was claimed off waivers by the Dolphins on Tuesday.
metadata.analysis: Wayne was waived by the Texans on Monday, though he was quickly scooped up by the Dolphins on Tuesday. The 26-year-old appeared in six regular-season games for Houston since the 2025 campaign, totaling six grabs (14 targets) for 65 yards.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne claimed off waivers by Dolphins
metadata.description: The Dolphins claimed WR Jared Wayne off waivers from the Texans.
metadata.analysis: Wayne will add depth in the wide receiver room for Miami.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne released by Texans
metadata.description: The Texans released WR Jared Wayne.
metadata.analysis: If Wayne clears waivers, he is expected to join the practice squad.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Cut loose by Houston
metadata.description: Wayne was waived by the Texans on Monday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
metadata.analysis: Wayne is the odd man out in the wide receiver room with Houston after the team announced Sunday that they have traded for third-year wideout Marvin Harrison from the Cardinals. Wayne has played in each of the Texans' five regular-season contests to this point, reeling in four of 12 targets for 65 targets. If the 26-year-old clears waivers, there's a strong chance that Wayne returns as a member of Houston's practice squad.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Seven targets in loss
metadata.description: Wayne caught two of his seven targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 20-6 loss to the Bengals.
metadata.analysis: Wayne saw a lot of attention due to the absence of Nico Collins (hamstring) in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver saw the third-most targets for the Texans, behind Dalton Schultz and Xavier Hutchinson but could not seem to catch most of them. Wayne played 40 of the team's 80 offensive snaps in the contest.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Staying in Houston
metadata.description: Wayne signed a reserve/future contract with the Texans on Tuesday.
metadata.analysis: Wayne spent most of the 2025 season on the Texans' practice squad and was elevated for Week 8 against the 49ers, when he played 35 offensive snaps and caught both of his targets for 20 yards. He'll be on Houston's 90-man roster when the offseason commences Feb. 9, which allows him to participate in OTAs and minicamp and make a good impression on the coaching staff before the start of training camp in July.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne signs future deal with Texans
metadata.description: The Texans signed WR Jared Wayne to a future contract.
metadata.analysis: Wayne will hold a depth role in the Texans wide receiver room heading into their offseason program.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Returns to practice squad
metadata.description: The Texans reverted Wayne to their practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Wayne was elevated for the first time this season ahead of Sunday's Week 8 matchup against San Francisco, as both Nico Collins (concussion) and Christian Kirk (hamstring) were unable to suit up. Wayne ended up logging 35 of the Texans' 80 offensive snaps (third-most among Houston's wideout corps) and caught both of his targets for 20 yards. Wayne's likelihood of being elevated again for Week 9 versus Denver could depend on whether Collins and/or Kirk is able to return to action.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Makes season debut
metadata.description: Wayne caught both of his targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 26-15 win over the 49ers.
metadata.analysis: Wayne was elevated from the practice squad due to both Nico Collins (concussion) and Christian Kirk (hamstring) being unavailable. He played 35 snaps, third-most among the wideouts, and recorded the first two receptions of his career after seeing action in three games during the regular season and one playoff game in 2024. He's eligible to be elevated from the practice squad on two more occasions this season while Collins and Kirk work their way back to full health.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Elevated to active roster
metadata.description: The Texans on Saturday elevated Wayne to the active roster for Week 8 against San Francisco.
metadata.analysis: Wayne will join Houston's active roster, which will be without both Nico Collins (concussion) and Christian Kirk (hamstring), both of whom were ruled out. Wayne is expected to serve as the fifth wideout on the depth chart behind Xavier Hutchinson, Jayden Higgins, Jaylin Noel and Braxton Berrios.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne elevated to Texans' active roster
metadata.description: The Texans elevated WR Jared Wayne to their active roster.
metadata.analysis: Wayne signed with Houston earlier this week. He will hold a depth role for the Texans with Nico Collins and Christian Kirk ruled out.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne signs with Texans
metadata.description: The Texans signed WR Jared Wayne.
metadata.analysis: Wayne lands back in Houston with Nico Collins in concussion protocol and Christian Kirk battling a hamstring injury. He remains off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Joins active roster
metadata.description: The Texans signed Wayne from their practice squad Wednesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
metadata.analysis: The 25-year-old from Pittsburgh adds much-needed depth to the Texans' receiving corps, as Nico Collins (concussion) and Christian Kirk (hamstring) are both dealing with injuries. Wayne appeared in three games with the Texans in 2024, failing to record an offensive stat over 64 total snaps (40 on offense, 24 on special teams). Now back with the active roster, he's likely to contribute on both offense and special teams in Houston's Week 8 matchup against the 49ers.

metadata.title: Jared Wayne - Returns to Texans on PS
metadata.description: Houston signed Wayne to its practice squad Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Wayne was waived by Houston in early August but didn't latch on a with a different team. Instead he's reuniting with the Texans, with whom he got into three regular-season games last year. Wayne also logged 10 offensive snaps in the team's AFC divisional-round playoff loss to the Chiefs.
